failures.question: My grandmother passed away. How much paid time can I take?
failures.answer: Brightwater Analytics gives every full-time employee paid time off for vacation and personal needs. [1] Bereavement leave gives you paid time to grieve and handle arrangements. [3]

failures.question: Does the company help pay for a master's degree?
failures.answer: Parents may return on a reduced schedule of 30 hours per week for the first four weeks back, at full pay. [1] Performance reviews help employees understand their impact and plan their growth. [2]

failures.question: I'm having a baby. How long can my partner stay home with pay?
failures.answer: Each employee receives a one-time home office stipend of $500 to buy a desk, chair, or other ergonomic equipment. [1] Parents may return on a reduced schedule of 30 hours per week for the first four weeks back, at full pay. [2]
